name: Trainer
description: Merge annotator datasets (zips) into one training project, choose training and validation sets and distortions, and train in the background: a YOLO model (saved as a model version the Annotator lists), or a model that gives the distance of a box alone (a formula, four regressors, a small neural network; they need only numpy and are kept in the project). Needs the Annotator add-on, and torch, ultralytics and (to be practical) a GPU in the Python you train with. A training project is a .training folder.
